asides.title: Side panels
asides.description: The overlay blurs the page; the pinned panel pushes its content. Both become overlays on phones.
asides.resizeHint: Drag the left edge or use arrow keys on the handle. Home/End selects the minimum/maximum width.
asides.placeholder: Content remains after closing the panel
asides.sample: Example section {number} — panel content scrolls independently of the page.

test.title: Component gallery
test.description: Every basic component in one place. Change variants, states and values to check their appearance and behavior.
test.editHint: Edit shared component styles in basic/styles.ts and popup styles in components/styles.ts. Popup and buttons use the same radius.control value.

cornerBadges.title: Button corner badges
cornerBadges.description: TrueGuard-style CornerBadge: an empty marker, a number (including zero), a 99+ counter or text. Choose a corner, color and value. Clear the value to show a dot.

test.userPanelV2: First the avatar, name and email row expands proportionally, widening the panel 200 px to the left. Then the details and buttons unfold downward. The background smoothly blurs from the start. Click the background or header, or press Escape, to reverse both stages. Width adapts on small screens. This is a preview — account navigation and logout confirmation are disabled.

notifications.title: Notification center
notifications.description: Try short confirmations and messages that stay in the bell after the strip collapses.

semanticColors.title: Semantic colors
semanticColors.description: Standard preserves the existing appearance. Other colors pair their background with readable text and hover/active states. Switch theme and high contrast to compare variants.
